speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I'm twenty-one right now, so I think that's quite young.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Being this age, we're able to do so many things legally, and we still have enough time.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Compared with older people, we have more time to achieve what we want; compared with younger people, we have more experience and a broader horizon.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So I think it's a good age — we can use our time to try things and explore different opportunities in life.
